name: Kanpur Plastipack Ltd
title: Kanpur Plastipack Ltd - 507779 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: FIBC utilisation ~83% on 18,000 t capacity with order lead times cut from 6-8 to 3-4 weeks; management guides ~10% top-line growth and flat margins, with DFIA reversal hitting Q4 and PP prices up ~65% to USD1,700/t.

utilisation.quote: So, 15,000 divided by 18,000 is about 83%. So yes, we utilize about 83%.

capex.quote: The FIBC expansion project at Unit 3 is progress as per plan, of which the building will be complete by May '26.

triggers.label: Lead times 6-8 wks → 3-4 wks
triggers.quote: lead times reducing from 6 to 8 weeks to 3 to 4 weeks now, reflecting both raw material volatility and cautious customer procurement

triggers.label: Customer inventory correction
triggers.quote: This is also partly due to inventory correction in the supply chain

triggers.label: PP RM ~USD1,000 → ~USD1,700/t
triggers.quote: Prices increased sharply from USD1,000 per ton to approximately USD1,700 per ton.

triggers.label: FY27 top line ~10% growth
triggers.quote: we should expect about a 10% increase in the top line

triggers.label: Non-woven entry, Rs20-25 cr FY27
triggers.quote: we should expect about INR20 crores to INR25 crores revenue only because the first machine would get commissioned by September

guidance.value: about 1,800 tons; run rate 2,400 tons by end FY27
guidance.quote: in this year we should expect about 1,800 tons and we should end the year with a run rate of 2,400 tons
we should expect about a 10% increase in the top line
I would say that we would maintain a similar number.
we should expect about INR20 crores to INR25 crores revenue only
On a revenue of INR100 crores to INR120 crores, we should look at an EBITDA of 15% to 16%.

red_flags.label: Other income / forex-trading reliance
red_flags.quote: So, because of the volatility that has been there in the foreign exchange as well, this was there. How it will be in the next year, it is hard to comment.

red_flags.label: DFIA income reversal in Q4
red_flags.quote: This quarter was impacted by a reversal of DFIA income amounting to INR3.65 crores, which led to negative other operating income of INR2.9 crores.

red_flags.label: Order book challenge
red_flags.quote: order book will remain a challenge in thi s quarter and the next quarter

evasions.quote: So, if somebody needs to order 1,000 pieces, he will order 500 pieces right now
How it will be in the next year, it is hard to comment.
